newsitem.title: USA: Rhone Rorer sees Q2 distribution.
newsitem.headline: Rhone Rorer sees Q2 distribution.

text.p: Rhone-Poulenc Rorer Inc (RPR) said Friday that Centeon Llc expects to resume distribution of plasma products in the second quarter of 1997.
Centeon is a joint venture between RPR and Hoechst AG.
Because Centeon doesn't know when all regulatory requirements will be satisfied, RPR said it continues to assess the effct on its yearly earnings outlook.
In March, Centeon interrupted manufacturing of plasma products to allow for full implementation of new production improvements, RPR said.
Recently, Centeon decided to briefly extend the suspension of manufacturing, which could result in some delay for Centeon in resuming distribution of certain plasma products, RPR said.

Centeon believes that all conditions of distribution under the consent decree signed in January, 1997 will be satisfied during the second quarter of 1997, enabling a phased-in resumption of manufacturing and distribution of newly manufactured plasma products to begin during the second quarter of 1997, RPR said.
